sections.Profile:
"Total Nuclear Annihilation" by Spooky Pinball, designed by Scott Danesi, is a unique retro-futuristic pinball game released in 2017. The machine features a distinct 80s-inspired aesthetic, complemented by a powerful built-in subwoofer for immersive sound. Key gameplay elements include three flippers, 11 standup targets, five slingshots, and a three-in-line drop target system that enables multi-ball play. Players aim to destroy nuclear reactors across multiple levels, creating an intense and engaging experience.
